import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 60;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long n;
    static int k;

    static int add(int x) {
        return x >= MOD ? x - (int)MOD : x;
    }

    static int sub(int x) {
        return x < 0 ? x + (int)MOD : x;
    }

    static int mul(int x, int y) {
        return (int)((long) x * y % MOD);
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int size;

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            }
        }

        void setId() {
            init();
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.size = size;
            long[][] tmp = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= size; j++) {
                    tmp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            long MODLL = (long)MOD * (long)MOD;
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= size; j++) {
                    for (int t = 1; t <= size; t++) {
                        tmp[i][j] += (long)a[i][t] * (long)rhs.a[t][j];
                        if (tmp[i][j] >= MODLL) {
                            tmp[i][j] -= MODLL;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= size; j++) {
                    res.a[i][j] = (int)(tmp[i][j] % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Matrix>> f, s, sumMat;
    static List<Integer> num;
    static int count;

    static void process() {
        num = new ArrayList<>();
        f = new ArrayList<>();
        s = new ArrayList<>();
        sumMat = new ArrayList<>();

        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            num.add((int)(tempN % k));
            tempN /= k;
        }
        count = num.size();

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            List<Matrix> fRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> sRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> sumRow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                Matrix mat = new Matrix();
                mat.size = k + 1;
                mat.init();
                mat.setId();
                for (int t = 1; t <= k + 1; t++) {
                    mat.a[t][t] = 1;
                }
                for (int t = 1; t <= k + 1; t++) {
                    mat.a[i + 1][t] = 1;
                }
                fRow.add(mat);
                sRow.add(new Matrix());
                sumRow.add(new Matrix());
            }
            f.add(fRow);
            s.add(sRow);
            sumMat.add(sumRow);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            s.get(0).set(j, f.get(0).get(j));
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < count; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                int idx = (j == 0) ? 0 : j;
                if (j == 0) {
                    s.get(i).set(j, s.get(i - 1).get(j));
                } else {
                    // sump[i-1][j-1] * s[i-1][j]
                    // Since sump is not explicitly defined, assuming it's similar to s
                    // and the original code's logic, we can interpret as:
                    s.get(i).set(j, s.get(i - 1).get(j - 1).multiply(s.get(i - 1).get(j)));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    s.get(i).set(j, f.get(i).get(j));
                } else {
                    s.get(i).set(j, f.get(i).get(j).multiply(s.get(i).get(j - 1)));
                }
            }
            for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                sumMat.get(i).set(j, sumMat.get(i).get(j + 1).multiply(f.get(i).get(j)));
            }
        }

        Matrix answer = new Matrix();
        answer.size = k + 1;
        answer.setId();

        int prefixSum = 0;
        for (int i = count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int numVal = num.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < numVal; j++) {
                int idx = (prefixSum + j) % k;
                answer = f.get(i).get(idx).multiply(answer);
            }
            prefixSum += num.get(i);
            prefixSum %= k;
        }

        int finalRes = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            finalRes = add(finalRes + answer.a[i][k + 1]);
        }
        System.out.println(finalRes);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        process();
    }
}
